_comment: Airport criticality tiers for cargo/supply-chain risk weighting. Keyed by IATA code. Not exhaustive - extend freely; an airport missing from this file is treated as tier_3 by default. Tier assignment is by cargo throughput/role, not passenger volume - a huge passenger hub with little freight role (e.g. a leisure-only airport) is correctly tier_3 here even if it's a major airport otherwise.

tier_1._note: Major global freight hubs - a disruption here has outsized supply-chain reach regardless of how it reads in passenger-traffic terms.

tier_2._note: Significant regional or national cargo gateways - real supply-chain weight, typically concentrated in one region or trade lane.

tier_3._note: Default tier for any airport not listed above - not a curated list, just the fallback.
